title: Code and results for: Zero- Versus Infinite-Temperature Damping in Variational Quantum Circuits
description:
Scripts, committed result files and LaTeX source behind every table and figure of the paper Zero- Versus Infinite-Temperature Damping in Variational Quantum Circuits: Feature Scale, Sampling Cost, and Frame Gauge (V.-Q.-M. Nguyen, T.-V. Truong, H.-L. Nguyen, T.-K. Le, 2026). The paper compares amplitude damping with its Pauli twirl, generalized amplitude damping at infinite temperature, in single-qubit re-uploading fits, a four-qubit MNIST classifier and a three-qubit variational eigensolver. The README maps each table and figure to the script and result file that produce it.

Licenses: code under MIT; result files and figures under CC BY 4.0 (LICENSE-CC-BY-4.0.txt); the manuscript files are not covered by these licenses.
